import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final input = await createExtractInputFromJson(json: '{"bytes":[116,111,107,101,110,45,55,52,50,57,32,101,109,97,105,108,101,100,32,97,108,105,99,101,64,101,120,97,109,112,108,101,46,99,111,109,46],"filename":"external-findings.txt","kind":"bytes","mime_type":"text/plain"}');
    final config = await createExtractionConfigFromJson(json: '{}');
    final findings = await Future.wait((jsonDecode(r'[{"label":"inspection_token","score":0.99,"text":"token-7429"}]') as List<dynamic>).map((element) => createExternalRedactionFindingFromJson(json: jsonEncode(element))));

  }
